headline: Zinc Miner Nexa and Buenaventura Rise Despite Brazil Market Crash
summary: Zinc producer Nexa Resources rose 1.39% to US$11.64 and Buenaventura gained 1.86% on Monday, defying the downward trend in Brazil's crashing market.
why: Mining companies listed internationally are sensitive to global industrial metal demand and underlying commodity prices rather than localized macroeconomic crises alone.

impacts.name: Nexa Resources S.A.
impacts.why: Rose 1.39% to US$11.64 despite broader regional market turbulence.
